digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mostly trade press updates par based hai. GST e-Way Bill mein abhi koi nai changes nahi aa rahe, aur Telangana HC ke kuch GST related judgments aaye hain.

items.headline: GSTN ne e-Way Bill enhancements abhi hold par rakha
items.detail: Trade reports ke mutabik, GSTN ne 1 August 2026 se apply hone wale proposed e-Way Bill changes ko abhi defer kar diya hai. Sabhi stakeholders ko bola gaya hai ki purane process continue rakho.
items.cga_view: Filhaal koi nai compliance requirement nahi, existing e-Way Bill process pe kaam karte raho. Koi advisory ya notification aaye to update zaroor dekho.

items.headline: Telangana HC: GSTAT appeal mein 10% pre-deposit nahi laga IGST paid hone par
items.detail: Telangana HC ne ek case mein taxpayer ko GSTAT appeal file karne ki permission di, bina mandatory 10% pre-deposit, kyunki IGST pehle se pay ho gaya tha. Yaha IGST vs CGST/SGST ka dispute tha.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka bhi IGST payment hogaya aur GSTAT appeal file karni hai, to relevant High Court order dikhakar pre-deposit waiver ki request kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Telangana HC: Seized documents milne par supplementary reply allowed in GST case
items.detail: Court ne bola after giving seized documents, taxpayer ko fir se detailed reply aur personal hearing ka mauka milega, aur adjudication limitation ke andar hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar department ne documents seize kiye hain to unki copy mang kar fresh reply aur hearing ki demand karein. Yeh aapka right hai, ignore mat karein.
